failures.title: Ford IQDB Engine Problems - What Actually Fails

items.title: Injector Failure & Fuel System Swarf Contamination - 2005-2015 models
items.whatHappens: The IQDB uses Delphi fuel injectors that are prone to internal wear and solenoid return spring failure. When they begin to fail, they shed microscopic metal swarf into the diesel fuel. This debris circulates through the high-pressure fuel pump, fuel lines, and fuel tank, destroying all fuel system components. If swarf enters the combustion chamber via leaking injector seals, it scores the cylinder walls and pistons, leading to total engine failure.
items.repairVsReplace: If caught immediately (often flagged by a misfire, rough running, or metallic ticking), replacing the injectors (£300-£800 each) and thoroughly flushing the fuel tank and lines may save the engine. However, if the engine has been run with contaminated fuel, cylinder scoring is likely, and a full Ford IQDB engine replacement is required. Read our full injector failure guide for early warning signs.

items.title: DPF Clogging & Turbo Actuator Failure - Urban use primarily
items.whatHappens: The 1.6 TDCi's diesel particulate filter (DPF) requires regular motorway driving to passively regenerate. Short, urban trips cause the DPF to clog, drastically increasing exhaust backpressure. This backpressure strains the turbocharger and its variable geometry actuator, often leading to turbo failure or actuator seizure.
items.repairVsReplace: A clogged DPF can sometimes be forced to regenerate or chemically cleaned (£400-£1,200). If the turbo actuator has failed, the turbo unit must be replaced or rebuilt. If the turbo has disintegrated and sent debris into the engine, a full Ford IQDB replacement is unavoidable. Read our full DPF clogging guide for prevention advice.

failures.goodYearsLine: The 1.6 TDCi is generally a robust engine block, but the Delphi injector and DPF issues are endemic to the 2005-2015 production run. Strict adherence to fuel filter changes every 30,000 miles and regular motorway driving significantly reduces the risk of these failures .

variants.title: How to Confirm You Have the Ford IQDB
variants.intro: The IQDB engine code is physically stamped on a machined pad on the engine block, typically located near the dipstick tube or where the block meets the gearbox bellhousing. It is also clearly listed on your vehicle’s V5C registration document under the engine code section. The IQDB is most commonly confused with the smaller 1.4 TDCi (which shares the same basic DV4 architecture but has different capacity, mapping, and physical dimensions) or the later 1.5 TDCi (DV6C) which replaced it in 2015. Fitting a 1.5 TDCi into an IQDB-configured vehicle without ECU remapping and loom adaptation will cause severe running issues, fault codes, and potential limp-mode activation. Always verify the exact IQDB code before authorising a swap.

buyingGuide.title: Buying a Replacement Ford IQDB - What to Choose

options.label: Used
options.body: A used Ford IQDB engine makes sense only if you have absolute documented proof that the fuel system is free of swarf contamination and the injectors have been recently replaced or tested. The primary risk with a used 1.6 TDCi is inheriting an engine with scored cylinder walls from previous injector failure. Explore vetted options via our used engines network.

options.label: Reconditioned
options.body: This is the strongly recommended choice for most Ford IQDB owners. A proper reconditioned Ford IQDB engine will include a verified clean fuel system, new or tested injectors, and a checked turbocharger. This directly addresses the dominant failure modes, providing a reliable, long-term solution without the premium cost of a full strip-and-rebuild. View reconditioned engines for detailed specifications.

options.label: Rebuilt
options.body: A full rebuild is justified if the cylinder walls were scored during an injector swarf contamination event, or if the turbocharger disintegrated and sent debris into the intake. A comprehensive rebuilt Ford IQDB engine should include new pistons and rings, a machined or replaced block, and all-new fuel system components. Learn more about rebuilt engines.

buyingGuide.supplyFitLine: Fitting a Ford IQDB through our network ensures the work is completed by specialists familiar with TDCi fuel system procedures, backed by a minimum 12-month warranty and nationwide delivery. Arrange supply and fit for complete peace of mind.
buyingGuide.vehicleValueNote: Early 1.6 TDCi host vehicles (Mk2 Focus, Mk6/Mk7 Fiesta, Mk1 C-MAX) typically hold a current UK market value of £1,200-£5,000 . With a reconditioned Ford IQDB replacement costing £1,590-£2,720 fully fitted, the total repair can easily exceed 50% of the vehicle's value, and on sub-£2,000 examples, it will exceed the vehicle's worth entirely. If the lowest viable replacement cost exceeds approximately 60% of the vehicle's current market value, evaluate scrap value before committing.

items.question: How much does a Ford IQDB engine replacement cost in the UK?
items.answer: A reconditioned Ford IQDB engine costs between £1,200 and £2,200 for supply only, or £1,590 to £2,720 fully fitted by an independent specialist. Used units start around £400 but carry a high risk of inherited injector swarf damage. Rebuilt units range from £2,000 to £3,200, addressing any cylinder scoring from prior contamination. items.question: What is the most common failure with the Ford IQDB engine?
items.answer: The dominant failure is Delphi injector failure and subsequent fuel system swarf contamination, typically occurring between 80,000 and 150,000 miles. Failing injectors shed microscopic metal debris into the diesel fuel, which circulates through the high-pressure pump and fuel lines, eventually scoring cylinder walls and causing total engine failure. Check if your vehicle is affected and compare rebuilt IQDB prices with the failure already addressed.

items.answer: The IQDB 1.6L Duratorq TDCi engine was fitted to the Ford Focus Mk2, Ford Fiesta Mk6 and Mk7, and Ford C-MAX between 2005 and 2015. It was offered in 90hp and 110hp tune levels across these models. Always verify your exact engine code on the V5C or engine block before ordering a replacement.
